description: The catalog of flows the product ships: named client work with a trigger, ready to be armed on an agent
client_copy: Lo que se repite queda armado como un flujo y anda solo.
_comment: THE MECHANISM IS THE ENGINE'S NOW, AND THIS PLUGIN IS ONLY ITS CATALOG.
Until 14/9/2026 this plugin WAS flows: a skill that shelled out to
`create_flow.py`, a Hermes engine plugin holding the promises guard, a
core surface mounting that guard on our engine, and a tab it flipped. All
four are gone (docs/own-agent-plan.md, wave 1). A flow is a file the
engine reads -- `engine/core/flows.py` --, the clock that runs it is
`engine/core/scheduler.py`, the tool that creates it is
`engine/core/tools/flows.py`, and the promises guard moved to
`engine/core/promises.py`, where the flows it checks actually live. The
Flows tab is not a plugin's to flip any more either: the engine declares
it, because what runs on its own is the engine's clock.
WHAT IS LEFT IS THE SEVEN CURATED FLOWS, under curated/ and not under
flows/, because they are not this plugin's own work: they are the catalog
of flows the product ships, and each one exercises only system skills --
approval, deliverable, artifact -- or a base capability every agent has:
answering out of hours, the inbox summary, cases left open, a complaint,
loading a new customer, a report with its sources, the Monday web round-up.
There is no whatsapp-support or research plugin for them to belong to, and
inventing one to hold a FLOW.md would be a manifest with nothing behind it.
If one is ever written, the flow moves into it and this list gets shorter.
THEIR FRONTMATTER IS STILL THE HERMES ONE (trigger_type, trigger_cron,
results) and the engine does not read it. Each one is revalidated against
engine/core/flows.py the day its capability is rebuilt, which is where the
plan puts that work.
